job.title: Sr. Machine Learning Engineer - AI
job.description:
Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

What you can expect:

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Machine Learning Engineer to join our team and play a key role in developing and maintaining our knowledge graph service. As a Machine Learning Engineer specializing in knowledge graphs, you will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and optimize algorithms and models that enable efficient representation, integration, and retrieval of structured and unstructured data.

Responsibilities:  

  • Architect and optimize large-scale Machine Learning workflows to process structured and unstructured data for knowledge graphs and search services; Architect and optimize large-scale Machine Learning workflows to process structured and unstructured data for knowledge graphs and search services;
  • Deploy, monitor, and maintain machine learning models (LLMs and agentic workflows) in a microservice environment using Docker, Kubernetes (AWS EKS), and internal platforms (ZCP);
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams of engineers, product managers, and domain experts to define requirements and implement scalable, production-ready Machine Learning services.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation for all AI search systems, workflows, and services using Confluence, Zoom Docs, and LucidChart;
  • Develop business logic for routing requests to Machine Learning models and managing feature stores;
  • Implement advanced authentication and security mechanisms for Machine Learning pipelines, including asymmetric JWT and secure key management (AWS KMS, internal CSMS.
  • Work with asynchronous, distributed messaging frameworks (AsyncMQ).
  • Optimize knowledge graph algorithms for performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Conduct research on cutting-edge Machine Learning, NLP, and knowledge graph techniques, evaluating external data sources to enhance search and document understanding capabilities;
  • Develop/maintain documentation, best practices, guidelines;
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team knowledge-sharing, best practices, and internal technical guidelines;
  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of AI search pipelines, including document understanding and retrieval systems, using libraries such as Docling;
  • Evaluate external data sources to enhance AI search/document understanding;
  • Develop performance metrics, monitoring systems, and optimizations for AI search pipelines to ensure scalability, efficiency, and low latency;
  • Develop and maintain AI-driven search and ranking algorithms for enterprise-scale information retrieval and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems;
  • Design and maintain data ingestion, preprocessing, and transformation pipelines for both structured and unstructured data, ensuring high data quality and reliability.

What we're looking for:

Requires a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Communications Engineering, a related field, or a foreign degree equivalent. Must have 3 years of experience in job offered or related occupation. Must have 3 years of experience in the following:

  • 3 years of experience in design, development, and deployment of document understanding and processing pipelines;
  • 3 years of experience in deploy, monitor, and maintain machine learning models (LLMs and agentic workflows) in a microservice environment using Docker, Kubernetes (AWS EKS), and internal platforms (ZCP);
  • 3 years of experience in evaluating external data sources to enhance AI search/document understanding;
  • 3 years of experience in developing performance metrics, monitoring systems, and optimizations for AI search pipelines to ensure scalability, efficiency, and low latency;
  • 3 years of experience in design and maintaining data ingestion, preprocessing, and transformation pipelines for both structured and unstructured data, ensuring high data quality and reliability;
  • 3 years of experience in architect and optimizing large-scale Machine Learning workflows to process structured and unstructured data for knowledge graphs and search services;
  • 3 years of experience collaborating with cross-functional teams of engineers, product managers, and domain experts to define requirements and implement scalable, production-ready ML services;
  • 3 years of experience optimizing knowledge graph algorithms for performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • 3 years of experience conducting research on cutting-edge Machine Learning, NLP, and knowledge graph techniques, evaluating external data sources to enhance search and document understanding capabilities;
  • 3 years of experience developing and maintaining AI-driven search and ranking algorithms for enterprise-scale information retrieval and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems;
  • 3 years of experience maintaining comprehensive documentation for all AI search systems, workflows, and services using Confluence, Zoom Docs, and LucidChart;
  • 3 years of experience developing business logic for routing requests to Machine Learning models and managing feature stores.
  • 3 years of experience implementing advanced authentication and security mechanisms for Machine Learning pipelines, including asymmetric JWT and secure key management (AWS KMS, internal CSMS.
  • Telecommuting work arrangement permitted: position may work in various unanticipated locations throughout the U.S. Position does not require domestic or international travel.

job.title: AMER Field Marketing Manager - Workvivo
job.description:
What you can expect

Workvivo is an employee experience platform designed to amplify workplace culture and foster employee engagement, regardless of location. Committed to customer satisfaction, Workvivo focuses on enhancing employees' working lives across diverse industries globally. As part of Zoom, an intelligent collaboration platform, Workvivo aligns with Zoom's mission to prioritize people, enabling meaningful connections, modern collaboration, and driving innovation in businesses and individual interactions.


*Strong preference for candidates in the Eastern Time Zone, ideally located in the greater Boston, MA area.
 

About the Team

You'll join the Global Field & Strategic Events team, sitting within the broader Growth & Demand Generation function. Our buyers are enterprise leaders including CHROs, CIOs, and Internal Communications leaders, so this role is built around account based marketing as its operating model. You'll execute 1:1 programs for our highest value US accounts, 1:few programs for tiered account clusters, and 1:many (ABX) motions that combine field, events, and digital to reach broader segments at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Executing tiered account-based field marketing programs across strategic US accounts, account clusters, and broader market segments

  • Building and managing regional field calendars in partnership with Sales and Sales Development leadership, tailored to account priority and deal stage

  • Owning pipeline generation and acceleration for the USA region, reporting performance against demand channel standards

  • Managing regional field and events budget, optimizing for pipeline efficiency and return on investment

  • Partnering with Sales Development, Sales, and Revenue Operations to ensure coordinated follow-up and attribution across all account tiers

What we’re looking for

  • Bring 5+ years of experience in field marketing, account-based marketing, or integrated marketing within B2B SaaS or enterprise technology

  • Execute tiered account-based marketing programs including one-to-one strategic account programs, one-to-few cluster programs, and one-to-many scaled programs

  • Demonstrate pipeline efficiency and contribution, reporting on pipeline per dollar and business impact metrics

  • Manage regional marketing budgets and report pipeline performance to senior leadership

  • Collaborate across Sales, Sales Development, and Demand Generation teams to align field programs with revenue goals

  • Present performance data and strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders

  • Have experience in SaaS, B2B technology, HR tech, employee experience, or adjacent categories

  • Travel regionally within the USA as required for field programs and account engagement

job.title: Lead Technical SEO Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect

This is a hands-on technical leadership role at the center of how Zoom gets found, understood, and surfaced across both traditional search engines and emerging AI-powered discovery platforms. You will own the technical SEO foundation across a complex, multi-platform web ecosystem spanning Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, and modern frontend frameworks, translating search strategy into scalable production solutions. Working closely with SEO and Website Engineering leadership, you will drive high-impact implementations, build reusable SEO capabilities and automation, and establish the engineering standards that keep Zoom's digital presence ahead of the curve. Your work connects directly to organic visibility, pipeline, and revenue, and your fingerprints will be on the architecture decisions that shape how Zoom shows up across Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and the next generation of agentic web experiences.


About the Team


You will be part of Zoom's Website Engineering team within the Online Business organization, a cross-functional group of web engineers, CMS specialists, SEO and AEO experts, and performance engineers who build and scale the technical foundation powering Zoom's global web presence. The team collaborates closely with Marketing, Product, Design, Content, and Localization to deliver fast, accessible, and AI-ready digital experiences. Technical excellence, a bias toward automation, and engineering-by-design are at the core of how we operate.


Responsibilities


  • Lead the technical SEO roadmap and execution across Zoom's global web ecosystem, owning high-priority initiatives driven by SEO analysis, audits, crawl data, search performance data, server logs, technical root-cause analysis, and business priorities.
  • Translate SEO and AEO requirements into technical designs, development specifications, production implementations, and ongoing maintenance across Optimizely CMS, WordPress, custom web applications, APIs, and modern frontend frameworks, ensuring requirements are incorporated throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Own technical solutions for crawlability, indexability, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, metadata, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, JavaScript rendering, client-side rendering, server-side rendering, static generation, incremental rendering, and search-friendly application architecture.
  • Build and scale reusable SEO capabilities including centralized metadata services, automated sitemap generation, structured-data components, redirect services, internal-linking systems, and standardized SEO configurations that platforms can inherit without repeated manual intervention.
  • Drive Core Web Vitals and web performance improvements, including LCP, INP, CLS, JavaScript execution, rendering performance, image optimization, font loading, third-party scripts, caching, CDN configuration, API performance, and server response times.
  • Develop automated testing, monitoring, dashboards, CI/CD quality gates, proactive alerting, and validation scripts that detect technical SEO issues and prevent regressions from reaching production across broken links, metadata, canonicalization, structured data, redirects, sitemaps, indexability, robots directives, duplicate URLs, internal linking, accessibility, performance, and rendering.
  • Establish the technical foundation for AEO and AI search by implementing structured data, semantic HTML, machine-readable metadata, entity and product schemas, and machine-readable endpoints; evaluate emerging AI-search and agentic-web standards and translate them into practical engineering requirements.
  • Define and maintain technical SEO standards and governance across Optimizely, WordPress, and custom applications, serving as the technical authority for SEO implementation within Web Engineering through reference architectures, launch-readiness criteria, design reviews, and code reviews.
  • Partner with SEO, Content, Product Marketing, Web Engineering, Product, and senior stakeholders to translate search strategy and business priorities into scalable technical solutions, improve Zoom's discoverability and representation across traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery platforms, and connect technical SEO initiatives to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.


What We're Looking For


  • 8+ years of experience in technical SEO, web engineering, or a related discipline, with a demonstrated track record leading technical SEO initiatives across large-scale websites and web applications in a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology environment; ability to connect technical SEO work directly to measurable organic visibility, acquisition, pipeline, and revenue outcomes.
  • Deep expertise in technical SEO fundamentals: crawlability, indexation, rendering, canonicalization, redirects, URL architecture, XML sitemaps, robots directives, structured data, internal linking, hreflang, and JavaScript-based web applications; hands-on proficiency with JavaScript, PHP, HTML, and CSS to diagnose and implement technical SEO fixes directly in the codebase and CMS, not only through engineering handoffs.
  • Proven experience improving web performance and Core Web Vitals, including diagnosing issues related to JavaScript execution, rendering, caching, CDN configuration, images, third-party scripts, APIs, and server performance.
  • Experience building scalable SEO capabilities, automation, monitoring, and CI/CD quality gates across enterprise CMS platforms such as Optimizely and WordPress; comfortable going directly into the CMS or codebase to implement configurations, standardize templates, and deploy SEO capabilities across multiple sites and applications without requiring a dedicated engineering sprint for every change.
  • Strong understanding of structured data, Schema.org, JSON-LD, semantic HTML, and the technical foundations required for AEO and AI-powered search, with familiarity with emerging AI search platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.
  • Strong analytical skills using tools such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Semrush, Ahrefs, Sitebulb, analytics platforms, and application observability tools; experienced in analyzing server logs and crawl logs to identify crawl blocks, indexation gaps, rendering failures, and visibility issues across Google, AI search platforms, and LLM crawlers, and translating those findings into prioritized, actionable fixes.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to influence engineering architecture, establish technical standards, and partner effectively with SEO, Web Engineering, Product, Marketing, Content, and senior stakeholders.

job.title: Zoom AI DevOps Engineer
job.description:
What you can expect


As a Zoom AI DevOps Engineer, you can expect to work on high-impact, large-scale systems that support ZoomAI and Machine Learning services. You'll be part of a fast-moving, technically advanced team focused on building and maintaining highly available (99.999%) services. This is a hands-on role with opportunities to grow, innovate, and contribute to Zoom’s cutting-edge AI initiatives.


About the Team

The ZoomAI DevOps team is a collaborative group dedicated to building scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure for ZoomAI and Machine Learning services. Comprising individuals with varying levels of experience, the team promotes an open atmosphere. Knowledge sharing, innovation, and practical problem-solving are integral to their daily operations.

Responsibilities

  • Maintaining ZoomAI services’ release deployment and maintenance.
  • Conducting in-depth investigations across various ZoomAI services and environments to identify architectural or operational inefficiencies.
  • Designing and implementing enhancements in deployment pipelines and CI/CD automation to improve reliability and accelerate release processes.
  • Designing and implement zero-downtime Zoom services (99.999%)
  • Developing CI/CD automation to maintain a scalable architecture.
  • Automating monitoring metrics, identify and troubleshoot service issues.

What we’re looking for

  • Have hands-on expertise in AWS Bedrock.
  • Demonstrate experience in Kubernetes and Docker.
  • Show skills in using Git, Jenkins, ArgoCD, and other DevOps tools.
  • Bring expertise in Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, and related monitoring tools.
  • Demonstrate expertise in programming using Python, Shell, and various scripting languages.
  • Own experience in writing and managing Ansible Playbooks and working with Ansible Tower.
  • Exhibit deep understanding of Linux systems and shell environments.
  • Bring experience with AWS cloud infrastructure.

job.title: Audio AI Engineer
job.description:
What you can expect

As an Audio AI Engineer, you will research and develop algorithms for accent conversion, voice conversion, speech synthesis, and speech recognition on low-latency streaming architectures. You’ll prototype and refine end-to-end audio models that enhance intelligibility and naturalness while maintaining speaker identity. Working closely with product and platform teams, you’ll help bring these models into real-time communication systems. You will also evaluate and optimize model performance across dimensions such as quality, latency, and scalability. Staying current with advances in speech processing, you’ll contribute to innovation through patents and internal knowledge sharing.

About the Team

Zoom's Audio team develops real-time audio features based on AI algorithms. Members of the team are spread worldwide, including the U.S., China and Singapore.

Responsibilities

  • Researching, designing, and developing algorithms for accent conversion, voice conversion, speech synthesis, and automatic speech recognition, focusing on low-latency streaming architectures.

  • Prototyping end-to-end audio models that enhance intelligibility and naturalness while preserving speaker identity and expressiveness.

  • Collaborating closely with product and platform teams to integrate models into real-time video and audio communication systems.

  • Analyzing and optimizing model performance across speech quality, latency, robustness, and scalability dimensions.

  • Staying current with the latest developments in speech processing research, and contribute to the community through patents, and internal knowledge sharing.

What we’re looking for

  • Hold a PhD or equivalent experience in a relevant field in Streaming, Accent Conversion, Voice Conversion, TTS, or ASR. More than 2 years of relevant industry experience considered a plus.

  • Show proficiency in deep learning frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

  • Demonstrate effective programming skills in Python, C/C++, or similar languages.

  • Have an understanding of sequence modeling architectures (Transformers, RNNs, diffusion models, or conformers).

  • Demonstrate experience developing and deploying low-latency, real-time speech or audio models with streaming architectures and optimized pipelines.

  • Show familiarity with model compression and acceleration techniques, including quantization, pruning, and distillation.

  • Exhibit experience working with real-time audio systems in networked communication environments.

  • Publish in top-tier conferences such as Icassp, Interspeech, NeurIPS, and ICLR.

job.title: Zoom Onboarding Specialist
job.description:
Zoom Onboarding Specialist

What You Can Expect

In this role, you will own the end-to-end onboarding experience for newly contracted customers in Japan, guiding them from kickoff through to a confident handoff to the Customer Success team. You will deliver live administrator and end-user training sessions independently, working directly with customers to drive successful adoption of Zoom Workplace, Zoom Phone, and Zoom Revenue Accelerator. Native-level Japanese fluency and the ability to create and localize training materials from English source content are required for this role. You will report to the US-based Zoom Onboarding Specialist (ZOS) manager and serve as the primary Japan market voice, sharing customer insights and shaping local onboarding processes.

About the Team

The Zoom Onboarding Specialist team sits within the Customer Success organization and plays a meaningful role in how customers experience Zoom from day one. We partner closely with CSMs, CSAs, Sales, and Renewals teams across Japan and globally to ensure every customer gets the foundation they need to grow and thrive. Our work directly influences product adoption, customer retention, and the long-term success of Zoom’s enterprise relationships.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver live customer training sessions, including administrator training, end-user training, and power-pack sessions, independently and with confidence.
  • Own the end-to-end onboarding journey for newly contracted accounts: kickoff coordination, configuration guidance, training delivery, and handoff to CSM/CSA.
  • Create and localize training materials by translating and adapting global English-language resources, including slide decks, guides, and FAQs, into Japanese.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with CSM, CSA, Renewals, and Sales teams in Japan to ensure seamless customer handoffs and aligned onboarding strategies.
  • Analyze customer onboarding trends and provide actionable feedback to internal stakeholders to uphold quality standards and address evolving product and customer requirements.
  • Communicate proactively with global ZOS leadership, sharing Japan market insights, customer feedback, and proposed process improvements to shape Japan-specific onboarding practices.
  • Partner with Customer Success leadership on an ongoing basis to surface onboarding successes, risks, and areas of opportunity.


What We’re Looking For

  • Demonstrated experience delivering live, customer-facing training sessions independently, including facilitation, Q&A management, and session ownership from start to finish.
  • Native-level Japanese fluency, written and spoken, combined with strong English reading comprehension to interpret and localize global source materials.
  • Ability to create and adapt customer-facing training resources, including slide decks, guides, and FAQs, for a Japanese-speaking audience.
  • Experience in a customer-facing role such as Customer Success, Technical Support, or Presales Engineering, or equivalent experience, with a SaaS or UCaaS product context preferred.
  • Proven ability to operate with high autonomy while staying aligned with a globally distributed team across time zones.
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to present to executive and key decision-maker audiences when required.
  • Collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset with the adaptability to thrive in environments where processes, products, and team structures evolve continuously.

job.title: Lead Technical Product Manager
job.description:
What You Can Expect

You will own and drive Zoom's Enterprise Infrastructure portfolio - covering data sovereignty, network resilience, and cryptographic key management for regulated customers in financial services, government, healthcare, and education. You'll define strategy, shape the roadmap, and lead execution across three interconnected pillars at the intersection of AI, real-time media, and enterprise security. This is a senior IC role requiring deep technical fluency, strong strategic judgment, and the ability to influence engineering, security, sales, and executive leadership without formal authority.


About the Team

Our team builds enterprise admin & infrastructure solutions that power secure, reliable, and compliant collaboration experiences. We operate at the intersection of platform infrastructure and customer-facing product, partnering closely with engineering, GTM, and security to ship product that is both technically rigorous and commercially impactful.


Responsibilities

  • Defining and executing a multi-quarter product architecture and roadmap, balancing customer-driven requirements with platform scalability and business impact.
  • Translating deep technical complexity into clear strategic narratives for executive audiences.
  • Partnering with Engineering, Security, Sales, and Customer Success to drive alignment and delivery. This portfolio touches every major Zoom product surface - you must be effective at influencing across organizational boundaries.
  • Partnering with enterprise customers and industry partners to identify requirements and shape product direction.
  • Driving product launches, adoption, and measurable business outcomes using customer and market insights.

What We're Looking for

  • 10+ years in technical product management, platform architecture, or systems engineering, security, and data sovereignty domains.
  • Have a deep understanding of real-time media networking, cryptographic key management , on-premises/hybrid cloud deployment models.
  • Demonstrate the ability to own a major product area end-to-end from strategy definition through execution and business impact measurement.
  • Have experience navigating complex, cross-cutting technical architectures that span multiple product surfaces and engineering teams.
  • Be familiar with regulated industries (financial services, government, healthcare, EDU) and their data residency, sovereignty, and compliance requirements.
  • Bring experience with enterprise sales motions involving hardware, proof-of-concept engagements, and multi-stakeholder procurement.
  • Possess a track record of managing high-revenue product portfolios with direct strategic customer engagement.

Minimum:

$146,700.00

job.title: Security DevOps Engineer
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a DevOps Engineer on Zoom’s Security DevOps team, you will work on high-impact infrastructure initiatives that power some of Zoom’s most security-critical production systems - including secrets management, secure service-to-service delivery, PKI, and secure deployment pipelines. This role blends software engineering, platform infrastructure/DevOps/SRE engineering, and security engineering. You will own projects end-to-end, from design through production rollout, while delivering measurable improvements to the security posture, reliability, and scalability of the platforms that protect Zoom and its customers. You are an experienced engineer who operates with minimal oversight, makes sound technical decisions, understandsDevOps and security/compliance best practices, and is recognized as a go-to contributor in at least one critical domain.

About the Team

At Zoom, our team delivers the infrastructure that secures production services and sensitive data. We work collaboratively across security, platform, and engineering partners to solve complex problems. Our team exists to reduce risk and enable safe, reliable product delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Designing and delivering security-focused infrastructure projects from concept to production implementation

  • Operating and enhancing security-critical production services with emphasis on reliability and resilience

  • Automating infrastructure and deployment workflows to minimize risk and reduce manual processes

  • Collaborating with security, platform, and engineering teams to implement secure system updates effectively

  • Enhancing observability and leveraging operational data to drive reliability and security improvements

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrate 3+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, or Platform/Infrastructure/Cloud Engineering

  • Have experience in SRE, DevOps, or Platform / Infrastructure / Cloud Engineering

  • Show expertise in managing large-scale production environments using Kubernetes-based systems.

  • Possess designing or operating security infrastructure (e.g., Vault, PKI systems, secrets delivery, identity systems, SDKs/APIs)

  • Have experience in at least one programming language used for production systems (e.g., Go, Python, Java)

  • Demonstrate experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, ArgoCD)

  • Able to build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and/or GitLab Runners

  • Have an understanding of observability and production monitoring in distributed systems

  • Demonstrate working experience in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, OCI)

  • Operate and designing infrastructure in AWS GovCloud or other regulated cloud environments (e.g., FedRAMP, IL5), with an understanding of compliance and boundary requirements

job.title: Network Engineer
job.description:
What you can expect

You will engineer and operate Zoom's global corporate network across campus, cloud, and remote environments. You will automate repetitive work and improve observability to keep the network reliable at scale. Your efforts directly support Zoom's product teams and AI initiatives.

About the Team

IT Network Engineering owns the infrastructure connecting Zoom's global workforce. We automate aggressively and build reliable tooling. We fix things properly — once.

Responsibilities:

  • Operating enterprise LAN/WAN infrastructure including switching, routing, wireless, and SD-WAN across global sites.

  • Administering firewall policies, Zero Trust remote access, and 802.1X network access control for secure connectivity.

  • Supporting cloud network connectivity and partnering with Security and Cloud Engineering teams on cross-functional projects.

  • Building automation scripts, playbooks, and Infrastructure-as-Code templates to reduce operational toil.

  • Maintaining runbooks, network diagrams, and change procedures to ensure operational clarity and knowledge sharing.

What we’re looking for

  • Have 5+ years of hands-on enterprise network engineering experience spanning LAN, WAN, and wireless environments.

  • Demonstrate strong TCP/IP fundamentals and packet-level troubleshooting skills (Layer 2 through Layer 4).

  • Operate firewalls (Palo Alto or equivalent) and Zero Trust platforms (Zscaler, Prisma Access, or equivalent).

  • Configure and troubleshoot 802.1X / NAC in an enterprise environment.

  • Manage Juniper (EX, QFX, SRX, MX) or equivalent routing and switching platforms.

  • Monitor networks using SNMP, NetFlow, syslog, or equivalent observability tooling.

job.title: Manager, Lifecycle & Email Marketing
job.description:
What You Can Expect

In this role, you will own the full lifecycle and email marketing function for Workvivo by Zoom, the AI-native employee experience platform trusted by over 10 million users across leading global enterprises. You will set the strategy for how prospects move from first interaction to qualified sales conversation, build and run the programmes that make that happen, and be directly measured on pipeline contribution. Working closely with regional demand generation, SDR managers, revenue operations, and product marketing, you will serve as the connective tissue between every channel investment and the pipeline it generates. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our Dublin, Ireland office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.


About the Team

The Workvivo growth team runs demand generation, campaigns, and SDR programmes across every major region, including North America, EMEA, LATAM, and APJ. Lifecycle and email sit at the centre of that motion, serving as the mechanism through which every channel investment either converts to pipeline or stalls. Our team operates with full ownership of strategy and delivery, partnering closely with sales and revenue operations to move fast and show measurable results.


Responsibilities

  • Own the global email programme end to end, including nurture, product and content sends, event follow-up, database re-engagement, and win-back campaigns
  • Build and send all campaign emails: construct templates, shape copy, define and segment audiences, configure workflows, and ship to deadlines without hand-off
  • Design, launch, and maintain all nurture programmes covering inbound follow-up, content and event follow-up, stalled lead re-engagement, and SDR nurture in partnership with regional SDR managers
  • Define and maintain the lifecycle stage model from first touch through to sales accepted opportunity, working with revenue operations to keep every region aligned to one definition
  • Own audience selection, send governance, contact frequency, and overlap management across regional and global sends to protect deliverability and sender reputation
  • Lead the content syndication channel: set offer and asset strategy, define lead acceptance criteria, own the nurture behind every syndication programme, and hold the channel to a pipeline conversion standard
  • Grow the marketable database by region and in local language, including Spanish (LATAM), Portuguese (Brazil), and other priority markets per Workvivo’s localisation framework, and report performance in revenue terms across conversion by stage, velocity, and cost per qualified opportunity

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience owning email and nurture in a B2B SaaS environment, with a track record of designing programmes from the ground up and measuring their impact on conversion, or equivalent experience
  • Deep, hands-on marketing automation capability in HubSpot and Salesforce, or in comparable platforms such as Marketo, Braze, or Eloqua, or equivalent experience
  • Demonstrated ability to build and ship email independently: template construction, list building, workflow setup, QA across clients, and delivery to deadline
  • Strong judgement across deliverability, segmentation, list hygiene, and testing disciplines, with comfort interrogating funnel data and building self-serve reporting
  • Experience running a paid lead source such as content syndication, with a clear point of view on how to make cold-acquired names convert to pipeline
  • Experience working across multiple regions and languages, and the ability to build and manage programmes that run natively in more than one language
  • Ability to work closely with sales and SDR teams and to present performance and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders using data

Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

What you can expect

We are seeking a talented engineer to join our AI Agent Experience team to help build the next-generation intelligent collaboration platform. Our team focuses on the experiential layer of multimodal AI Agent capabilities, deeply integrated into the Zoom Workplace ecosystem. As well as redefining meetings, communication, and collaboration through Agents.

About the Team

You will play a key technical role, leading core architecture design and tackling complex systems, collaborating with top engineers globally to define AI-driven future work methods.

Responsibilities:  

  • Architect and develop core AI Agent functionalities using Python and Java, ensuring high-performance, fault-tolerant, and high-availability backend systems that are deeply integrated into Zoom’s global platform;
  • Design and implement distributed system components and APIs supporting multimodal AI Agents that handle real-time communication, meeting automation, and intelligent task management;
  • Lead cross-functional engineering initiatives by collaborating with product managers, designers, and AI researchers to integrate large language model (LLM)–based capabilities into enterprise collaboration workflows;
  • Analyze complex technical requirements and propose scalable design solutions aligned with Zoom’s architectural standards and data security protocols;
  • Mentor global engineering teams, sharing specialized expertise in distributed system optimization, database design (MySQL/PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka), and microservice deployment (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Drive system innovation by identifying and resolving performance bottlenecks, enabling continuous optimization across largescale, cloud-native environments;
  • Ensure alignment between AI feature development and enterprise product strategy, contributing to architecture design reviews and technical roadmaps for AI Agent Experience products; and
  • Facilitate cross-border collaboration between global R&D centers, coordinating with engineering teams in North America and Asia to ensure consistent standards, integration, and delivery of AI-driven collaboration tools.

What we're looking for:

Requires a Bachelor's degree in Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or a foreign equivalent. Must have 3 years of experience in job offered or related occupation. Must have 3 years of experience in the following:

  • 3 years of experience In-depth understanding of AI Agent architecture, including distributed system design and integration with front-end and AI model services;
  • 3 years of experience with Advanced proficiency in Python and Java backend systems, including experience with microservices, API frameworks, and data orchestration pipelines;
  • 3 years of experience with Strong background in database optimization (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB) and middleware (Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch);
  • 3 years of expertise in containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes for large-scale deployments;
  • 3 years of experience and familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) and AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) to enhance engineering efficiency; and

job.title: Sales Development Manager, Workvivo
job.description:
What you can expect

Workvivo is the employee communications platform trusted by some of the world's most recognisable brands, now scaling globally as part of Zoom. We connect millions of employees to their companies' culture, leadership and purpose and our Sales Development org is a critical engine of that growth.

We're hiring a Sales Development Manager to lead our EMEA & APJ Sales Development team. You'll manage a team of SDRs across the region, reporting directly to the Head of Sales Development. You'll be responsible for turning strategy into execution — driving pipeline performance, developing your team, building a strong coaching culture and ensuring our EMEA & APJ SDR motion operates with pace, consistency and discipline.

We're looking for a hands-on leader who coaches in the trenches, knows how to develop SDR talent and can create the environment where people consistently perform at their best.


About the team

Workvivo operates at the intersection of employee communications and employee insights, serving mid-market and enterprise companies globally. Our buyers are CHROs, CTOs, CIOs and Internal Comms Directors — a senior, multi-stakeholder profile that rewards insight-led, persona-aware outreach over high-volume spray approaches.

This is a genuinely exciting moment to join. Workvivo recently launched Seer, our employee insights solution, bringing listening, analytics and action into a single platform alongside our communications product. And with Workvivo HQ — our AI-native employee experience platform — now in market, we have a compelling, expanded story to take to enterprise buyers. Two strong products, a rapidly expanding global footprint, and the backing of Zoom's worldwide network: the opportunity to build pipeline at scale and make a material impact on Workvivo's next chapter of growth has never been greater.

The EMEA & APJ SDR team operates a balanced motion: structured outbound sequencing into target accounts alongside managed inbound response. You'll be responsible for ensuring the team executes both motions effectively, understands when to prioritise each and consistently delivers high-quality pipeline to the sales organisation.


Responsibilities

  • Own EMEA & APJ Sales Development Representative performance - deliver against regional meeting, SQO and pipeline targets, with clear focus on the inputs and behaviors that drive results
  • Translate global strategy into EMEA & APJ execution - ensure global SDR priorities, playbooks and programmes are adopted effectively across the region
  • Build a daily coaching culture - coach reps through call reviews, roleplay, 1:1s and live feedback to continuously improve performance
  • Develop and retain talent - identify high performers, create development plans and address performance gaps with clear expectations and support
  • Drive strong outbound and inbound execution - ensure consistent standards across prospecting, sequencing, qualification, follow-up and handoffs
  • Identify and resolve regional blockers - surface issues across process, data, tooling, routing and skills, and work with the Global Head and cross-functional teams to address them
  • Partner with Sales and Marketing - strengthen meeting quality and pipeline conversion while ensuring EMEA & APJ SDR activity aligns with campaigns and ABM priorities
  • Feed EMEA insight into the global SDR organisation - share what is working, what isn't and where regional learnings should influence the wider SDR strategy


 

What we're looking for

  • Have 2+ years’ experience managing SDR or BDR teams in a B2B SaaS environment
  • Have a proven track record of delivering against pipeline and revenue targets through a Sales Development team
  • Have experience leading both outbound and inbound motions, with a strong understanding of what drives conversion across each
  • A coaching-first leadership style - you spend time with reps, listen to calls, run roleplays and actively develop capability
  • Have experience developing SDR talent, managing performance and creating clear pathways for progression
  • Have commercial acumen - you understand pipeline economics, conversion rates and the levers that influence SDR performance
  • Data-driven and operationally disciplined, with the ability to identify performance gaps and turn insight into action
  • Be comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and bringing structure, energy and accountability to a team

job.title: Software Engineer
job.description:
What you can expect

Design, build, and own the data pipelines, models, and products that power sales, customer success, and revenue analytics for Zoom's Go-To-Market organization. Partner with business and finance teams to build data systems that power both human analysts and AI agents. Build and ship data products end-to-end using AI-powered tools with full autonomy over the pipeline.

About the Team

We build the data foundations that power Zoom's revenue operations. Our team partners across Go-To-Market, Finance, and Engineering to deliver trusted, scalable data products for both business stakeholders and AI-driven workflows. We value curiosity, collaboration, and a shared commitment to making data accessible and actionable for every team we support.

Responsibilities

  • Acting as the technical lead/primary engineer for Go-To-Market, Revenue Operations, and Sales translating complex business problems, including forecasting, attribution, and churn, into production-grade data products.

  • Treating AI as core engineering multiplier: use agentic tools (like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for rapid prototyping, architecture design, refactoring, and code review. Build LLM-assisted workflows such as automated schema mapping and natural-language query layers.

  • Designing and build data models (Kimball, Data Vault), scalable pipelines that ingest and transform Go-To-Market data from Salesforce, product usage, billing, and customer success systems.

  • Building unified semantic layers and data marts that connect diverse source systems. Establish data contracts, schema governance, and lineage standards to ensure reliable downstream consumption.

  • Balancing real-time streaming architectures (Kafka, event-driven pipelines) with modern batch warehouse patterns, working across Snowflake/Databricks, DBT, Fivetran, and Airflow.

  • Applying software engineering discipline CI/CD, automated testing, version control to build data quality, observability, and monitoring frameworks; mentor peers, contribute to documentation and governance reviews.

What we’re looking for

  • Have a Bachelor's in Computer Science or Software Engineering. Brings 6+ years of experience in software engineering, data architecture, or forward-deployed engineering and a track record of shipping production-grade data systems.

  • Have expert proficiency in Python and advanced SQL, hands-on experience in cloud data warehouses or lakehouses (Snowflake, Databricks), transformation tooling (dbt), and orchestration (Airflow, Dagster).

  • Demonstrate excellent background in data modeling methodologies (Kimball, Data Vault, dimensional modeling, semantic layer design) applied to complex enterprise domains. Ideally revenue operations or Go-To-Market contexts such as Salesforce, marketing automation, or product telemetry.

  • Demonstrate use of AI coding tools (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and agentic workflows as an integrated part of daily engineering. Not just experimentation along with genuine interest in embedding LLMs into data workflows (text-to-SQL, automated cataloging, generative data quality testing).

  • Work knowledge of real-time event streaming and ingestion architectures (Kafka, event buses, webhooks), familiarity with modern software practices including CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and test-driven development.

  • Have a forward-deployed mindset consultative, resilient in ambiguity, and focused on user impact and delivery speed. With the ability to communicate complex architectural trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders while maintaining credibility with engineering teams.

job.title: EMEA Scale Campaigns & ABM Manager - Workvivo
job.description:
What you can expect

Workvivo is investing in a scaled account based marketing motion and is seeking someone to own it end to end. This role connects marketing, SDR, and sales teams. The position involves transforming account insights into actionable strategies by identifying accounts, building data foundations, and collaborating with SDR and AE teams.


It requires expertise in guiding SDR and AE leaders on account prioritization. Candidates with experience managing tiered strategies and distinguishing between activity and pipeline will thrive in this role. The focus is on delivering impactful and timely initiatives that drive success across targeted accounts.


About the Team

This role is part of the Global Field and Strategic Events team within Growth and Demand Generation. It focuses on account-based marketing strategies. Responsibilities include executing personalized programs for top US accounts, targeted programs for account clusters, and broader initiatives combining events, digital, and field efforts.


The target audience includes enterprise leaders such as CHROs, CIOs, and Internal Communications professionals. The role emphasizes creating impactful marketing motions to engage key stakeholders and scale efforts effectively across various segments, ensuring alignment with strategic goals and priorities.


Responsibilities

  • Managing Workvivo’s tiered ABM motion involves 1:1 for specific strategic accounts, 1:few for account clusters, and 1:many for programmatic engagement at scale.
  • Building and maintaining the account scoring and intent framework determines the appropriate tier placement and timing for account transitions.
  • Designing and managing multi-channel campaigns that integrate outbound, paid, and content efforts, ensuring accounts experience a unified approach rather than fragmented interactions.
  • Collaborating directly with SDR leaders to convert account priorities into structured sequencing, cadence, and outreach strategies.
  • Partnering directly with AE teams on account planning, defining shared transfer criteria, and ensuring joint accountability for pipeline within target accounts.
  • Managing the enrichment and intent data stack while overseeing associated vendor relationships.
  • Reporting on ABM performance involves using account-level metrics like engagement, penetration, and pipeline influenced, rather than focusing solely on activity volume.
  • Collaborating with Marketing Ops and RevOps ensures accurate account and contact data, as scaled processes quickly fail when the information is incorrect. Adapting the motion by region, recognizing that EMEA, LATAM, and APJ will not run the same play at the same pace.

What we’re looking for

  • Demonstrate experience using an intent or account scoring platform such as 6sense, Demandbase, or similar within a production environment.
  • Demonstrate experience with enrichment and data orchestration tools (Clay, ZoomInfo, Clearbit, or similar) and how to connect them cleanly into a CRM.
  • Demonstrate proficiency in Salesforce and a sequencing tool like Outreach, including understanding how account and contact data transfers between platforms.
  • Demonstrate over six years of experience developing and managing tiered account-based marketing strategies effectively.
  • Direct experience as an SDR or working alongside SDR and AE teams on the same accounts, with shared ownership of outcomes.
  • Comfort presenting account level and pipeline metrics to stakeholders in clear, accessible language.
  • Operate effectively across various regions or markets.
  • Develop an ABM function from an initial or unstructured phase into a well-organized, tiered approach.
  • Possess experience in SaaS or B2B technology within an organization utilizing a distributed or hybrid sales structure.

  • Have collaborated with the Alliances that drive the Zoom ecosystem. i.e Poly, Dten, NEAT, Oracle, Ribbon, Jabra, Verint.

يُعزز مدير حسابات القنوات إيرادات المبيعات من خلال بناء علاقات متينة مع الشركاء في المملكة العربية السعودية. ويتعاون مع الشركاء في وضع خطط التسويق والتدريب وتلبية احتياجاتهم. كما يُساهم في دفع عجلة النمو من خلال برامج القنوات، ويتوافق مع الأهداف مع الحفاظ على رضا العملاء.

نبذة عن الفريق
يُمثل فريق مبيعات Zoom قوة دافعة لنجاح الشركة. ويركز الفريق على تقديم حلول اتصالات متطورة للعملاء في جميع القطاعات، ويتفاعل بحماس مع العملاء حول العالم. ومن خلال الشراكات الاستراتيجية والنهج الذي يضع العميل في صميم اهتمامه، يلعب الفريق دورًا محوريًا في توسيع نطاق حضور Zoom العالمي، وضمان استفادة الشركات من الإمكانات الكاملة للتعاون الافتراضي.

  • خبرة في التعامل مع موزعي SaaS في المملكة العربية السعودية
  • امتلاك فهم عميق لنظام الشركاء البيئي
  • امتلاك مهارات تواصل وتفاوض ممتازة للتعاون بفعالية مع الشركاء وأصحاب المصلحة الداخليين.

job.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer, Platforms
job.description:
What You Can Expect

As a Lead Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will be one of the technical leads for our DevOps Platforms organization. This group is responsible for DevOps Platforms including cloud infrastructure, physical data center orchestration, critical security services, and our Zoom for Government (ZfG) environment. You will be an uber tech lead working across a broad area, defining projects and guiding work across various teams. Your scope of work is wide and you will have the opportunity to improve our datacenter kubernetes infrastructure, our cloud infrastructure, our security posture, and our operation of ZfG environments. Broadly speaking, you are an exemplary SRE and you will guide all of our teams toward SRE best practices (automation, monitoring, infrastructure as code, etc).

About the Team

The DevOps Platforms organization owns the full infrastructure stack: cloud infrastructure on AWS and OCI, physical data center orchestration, critical security services (identity, authentication, authorization), and Zoom's FedRAMP-rated federal environment, Zoom for Government (ZfG).

The team is currently working on one of the most technically interesting work in the org, hardening our security posture, and building the automation and reliability systems that underpin Zoom's global services. If you want broad visibility, real cross-team influence, and the chance to define how infrastructure gets built, this is the seat.

Responsibilities

  • Design and scale DevOps platform services including Kubernetes infrastructure, cloud systems, and compliance-ready environments
  • Define technical roadmaps and architectural direction for infrastructure automation and security
  • Partner with service teams to understand platform needs and deliver solutions that improve reliability and efficiency
  • Establish and advocate for SRE best practices including infrastructure as code, monitoring, and incident management
  • Mentor team members through design, implementation, and production deployment of complex systems

What We're Looking For

  • Bring 8+ years of SRE or DevOps experience building and operating production infrastructure at scale
  • Code proficiently in at least one programming language beyond scripting (e.g., Python, Go, Java)
  • Deploy and manage CI/CD pipelines using tools like Git, Jenkins, Argo CD, or JFrog
  • Operate cloud infrastructure on AWS, OCI, or similar platforms using Terraform and Kubernetes
  • Implement observability solutions with logging and monitoring tools such as ELK, Prometheus, or Grafana
  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences including security teams, senior leadership, and external auditors
  • Participate in on-call rotations and lead incident response to maintain system reliability
  • Hold a degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Hold US citizenship, or Greencard status

Preferred

  • Have experience with security from an SRE perspective
  • Have experience with Identity security (e.g. IAM, workload identity, zero trust) and tools (e.g. Teleport, Okta)
  • Have experience operating Government environments and understanding their compliance requirements
  • Have experience with system design and distributed computing at scale
  • Ability to speak Chinese/Mandarin is a plus, but not required

job.title: Software Development Engineer
job.description:
What You Can Expect

Join the Zoom Contact Center engineering team at a genuinely exciting moment: we are building an AI-powered analytics engine that acts as a virtual data analyst for our customers, moving beyond traditional reporting to create intelligent agents capable of understanding natural language and reasoning through complex data problems. As an entry-level backend engineer, you will work alongside experienced engineers to implement backend services that power AI reasoning, planning, and analytical tasks — gaining foundational skills at the intersection of scalable systems and modern AI development. The work you build here will directly shape how contact center teams around the world access insight and make decisions. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our San Jose, CA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.

About the Team

The Zoom Contact Center team is at the forefront of Zoom’s next-generation cloud-based customer engagement platform. We are building intelligent agents capable of understanding natural language and reasoning through complex data problems, providing actionable insights that improve contact center efficiency. We move fast, collaborate closely, and care deeply about the quality and impact of what we ship.

Responsibilities

  • Implement backend services using Java and Spring Boot to support AI-powered applications within the Zoom Contact Center platform.

  • Build prompt strategies, context management logic, and basic agent workflows in collaboration with senior engineers.

  • Develop task execution logic, data handling pipelines, and error management for AI-driven data flows.

  • Instrument services with logging and monitoring tools to track performance, latency, and correctness across testing and production environments.

  • Collaborate with data scientists, product managers, and senior engineers to translate analytical requirements into working, production-ready code.

  • Contribute to production-grade AI evaluation and orchestration pipelines (LLMOps), working with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus), semantic search, AI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen), and large-scale OLAP databases (ClickHouse).

What We’re Looking For

  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (recently graduated or within the last 1–2 years), or equivalent experience, with foundational software engineering exposure through internships, coursework, or personal projects.

  • Familiarity with backend programming in Java, Python, or a similar object-oriented language.

  • Basic understanding of relational (SQL) or non-relational (NoSQL) database design.

  • Curiosity and foundational knowledge of AI concepts, Large Language Models (LLMs), or AI orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel) gained through projects or coursework.

  • Eagerness to learn distributed systems, real-time streaming protocols (WebSockets), and LLMOps practices in a fast-paced environment.

$73,300.00

Maximum:

$169,500.00

job.title: UC Advisor UK & Ireland
job.description:
What You Can Expect

In this role, you will work at the intersection of consultative selling and cloud communications, helping UK&I organisations move beyond legacy telephony to an intelligent, AI-first experience with Zoom Phone. You will partner closely with Account Executives and channel partners to drive net-new and upsell opportunities across the Mid-Market and Enterprise segments, supporting the full sales cycle from discovery through to close. This is a high-impact specialist sales position where your deep UCaaS expertise shapes how customers understand and adopt the future of business communications. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 2 days per week at our London, UK office.

About the Team

The Zoom Phone sales team sits at the heart of Zoom Workplace, helping organisations replace legacy telephony with a cloud-native, AI-first communications platform. We work alongside Account Executives and channel partners with a consultative, customer-centric approach, showing businesses how voice, meetings, chat, and AI come together in a single solution. Our mission is to grow Zoom’s presence across UK&I by demonstrating that modern telephony is about unlocking the intelligence within every conversation.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Account Executives and channel partners to identify, develop, and close net-new and upsell Zoom Phone opportunities across Mid-Market and Enterprise segments
  • Deliver customer-specific Zoom Phone and AI-driven services demos tailored to each prospect’s business needs
  • Design and execute product and solution training programmes for Sales Engineers and channel partners
  • Drive pipeline hygiene by accurately tracking bookings, opportunities, and forecasts against quota in Salesforce CRM
  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of Zoom’s product differentiators, competitive landscape, and UCaaS sales methodologies
  • Serve as an escalation point for strategic opportunities, providing senior-level expertise to accelerate deals
  • Collaborate with internal product teams to surface customer feedback and influence product direction
  • Identify new ways to develop Zoom’s UCaaS go-to-market strategy across the UK&I region

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in a Direct Sales or Sales Overlay role within the UCaaS, Cloud PBX, or telephony space (e.g. CUCM, Avaya, Microsoft), covering Mid-Market and Enterprise segments
  • Proven track record of direct Cloud PBX/UCaaS product sales with consistent attainment against quota
  • Established channel partner relationships and an industry network that drives opportunity and engagement in the UK&I market
  • Demonstrated ability to lead executive-level conversations with C-Suite and VP-level stakeholders, addressing complex business needs
  • Strong financial selling acumen, including ROI and TCO analysis for UCaaS and AI-driven solutions

job.title: Majors/Commercial Account Executive (Tokyo Based)
job.description:
What you can expect

Zoom is looking for a hunter and prospector to create and win opportunities for our full suite of Zoom solutions. This team focuses on working with existing and new growing organizations with 501~ employees in Japan. As a Majors/Commercial Account Executive, you will position, sell and provide them with our cutting-edge AI Zoom workplace solutions based on their business needs. You will develop potential clients in Singapore and be in charge of end-to-end sales activities. You will report to the local Sales Leader and work with the local sales and cross-functional teams to drive Zoom's business growth in Japan.

About the Team

The Zoom sales team is a dynamic force driving the company's success. With a focus on delivering cutting- edge communication solutions for clients across all sectors, the team passionately engages with clients worldwide. Through strategic partnerships and a customer-centric approach, they play a pivotal role in expanding Zoom's global presence and ensuring businesses harness the full potential of virtual collaboration.

What we’re looking for

  • Have 5+ years of successful Account Executive experience in high growth SaaS/IT company

  • Have experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools and other sales applications.

  • Understand of outreach methods to approach new clients, and a good new business hunter profile with an ownership mindset.

  • Have excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to build relevant, strategic narratives and messaging.

  • Develop new accounts and expand business within Zoom's existing accounts, leveraging partnerships and handling complex sales scenarios and large projects.

  • Have a good skill cross collaboration and relationship building.

  • Have native Japanese skill (mandatory) and Business Fluency in English (highly welcomed)



期待される役割

Zoom では、Zoom ソリューションの全製品群における商談機会の創出と獲得を担うハンター兼プロスペクターを募集しています。このチームは、日本国内の従業員数 501 名以上の既存および新規成長企業との協業に注力しています。Majors/Commercial アカウントエグゼクティブとして、お客様のビジネスニーズに基づき、最先端の AI を活用した Zoom ワークプレイスソリューションの提案・販売を行っていただきます。日本における潜在顧客の開拓を担当し、エンドツーエンドの営業活動を主導していただきます。現地のセールスリーダーに報告し、現地の営業チームおよび部門横断チームと協力して、日本における Zoom のビジネス成長を推進していただきます。

チームについて

Zoom の営業チームは、同社の成功を牽引するダイナミックな組織です。あらゆる業界のクライアントに最先端のコミュニケーションソリューションを提供することに注力し、世界中のクライアントと情熱的に関わっています。戦略的パートナーシップと顧客中心のアプローチを通じて、Zoom のグローバルプレゼンスの拡大において重要な役割を果たし、企業がバーチャルコラボレーションの可能性を最大限に活用できるよう支援しています。

求めるスキル/ご経験

  • 高成長中のSaaS/IT 企業における5 年以上のアカウントエグゼクティブ成功実績

  • 顧客関係管理(CRM)ツールおよびその他の営業アプリケーションの使用経験

  • 新規顧客へのアプローチ方法の理解、およびオーナーシップマインドセットを持つ優れた新規ビジネスハンターであること

  • 関連性の高い戦略的ナラティブとメッセージングを構築できる優れたコミュニケーション能力とプレゼンテーション能力

  • 新規アカウントの開拓と Zoom の既存アカウント内でのビジネス拡大、パートナーシップの活用、複雑な営業シナリオや大規模プロジェクトへの対応

  • 優れた部門横断的な協業能力と関係構築スキル

  • ネイティブレベルの日本語スキル(必須)およびビジネスレベルの英語力(歓迎)

job.title: Head of Sales Operations
job.description:
What you can expect

You will design the strategy and systems powering Zoom's go-to-market execution. You will partner cross-functionally to build a data-driven operating model. You will transform how Zoom forecasts and grows.

About the Team
Our team powers the planning, analytics, and systems behind Zoom's revenue engine. We partner cross-functionally turning strategy into execution. We make growth predictable and scalable.

Responsibilities

  • Leading end-to-end revenue planning — including annual planning, segmentation, territory design, capacity modeling, quota setting, and investment allocation — to translate company strategy into an executable go-to-market plan.

  • Owning the forecasting operating model and pipeline analytics infrastructure, building disciplined processes that give leadership clear visibility into performance, risk, and opportunity.

  • Driving Customer Success Operations including renewal models, churn analysis, account health scoring, adoption metrics, and expansion analytics to connect new business, retention, and customer value realization.

  • Partnering with Sales, Finance, HR, Marketing, and Data & Automation teams to operationalize compensation plans, pipeline generation, funnel conversion, and AI-driven productivity improvements across the revenue organization.

What we’re looking for

Essential:

  • Demonstrate significant experience leading Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Operations in a B2B SaaS or enterprise software environment.

  • Apply deep expertise in revenue planning, coverage models, territory design, capacity planning, and quota setting to build scalable go-to-market frameworks.

  • Build and manage forecasting models, pipeline analytics, deal inspection processes, and executive-level revenue visibility.

  • Design and improve sales processes, CRM governance, operating rhythms, and rules of engagement across a complex revenue organization.

  • Develop and operationalize sales compensation plans, incentive structures, commission rules, and performance tracking aligned to company strategy.

  • Lead or partner closely with Customer Success Operations on renewals, adoption, churn analysis, account health, and risk scoring.

  • Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations for senior leadership, driving cross-functional alignment in a matrixed organization.

Preferred:

  • Bring working knowledge of marketing funnel dynamics, lead management, pipeline generation, campaign attribution, and how AI and automation can improve revenue execution and seller productivity.

What You Can Expect

In this role, you will design and ship AI-powered features within Zoom's Workforce Engagement Management (WEM) platform, directly improving how enterprise organizations forecast, schedule, and coach their teams. Working alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and data scientists, you will take ownership of features from initial design through production deployment. You will contribute to some of the most forward-looking work in the WEM space, from LLM-powered simulation environments to intelligent notification systems and AI-driven quality scoring pipelines. This is a hands-on role with meaningful mentorship from senior engineers and real impact on thousands of enterprise users from day one. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 3 days per week at our San Jose, CA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.

About the Team

The Workforce Engagement Management team at Zoom builds intelligent systems that help organizations manage, forecast, and optimize workforce performance. Our suite of WFM and QM products sits at the intersection of AI and enterprise collaboration, and we are actively pioneering the use of generative AI and LLMs to shape the next generation of contact center experiences. We work at meaningful scale, with a culture that values curiosity, experimentation, and shared ownership.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain AI-driven features for WFM and QM products using LLMs and prompt-based architectures.

  • Develop, fine-tune, and evaluate prompts and models for conversational and decision-support use cases.

  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing workflows and production systems.

  • Contribute to model evaluation frameworks and feedback loops that improve AI accuracy, reliability, and user experience.

  • Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and cross-functional syncs to ensure high-quality, scalable software delivery.

  • Identify and resolve production issues, contributing to root cause analysis and preventive measures.

  • Write clean, well-tested, and well-documented code following team engineering standards.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Strong programming skills in Python (preferred) or Go/Java, with foundational understanding of machine learning, NLP, or LLM architectures.

  • Familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or LangChain.

  • 0-1 years of professional software engineering experience; new graduates are welcome to apply.

  • Experience or coursework in prompt engineering, LLM fine-tuning, or AI workflow orchestration (internship or project experience counts).

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across functions.

  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerized deployments (Docker/Kubernetes), or MLOps tooling is a plus.

job.title: Staff AI Engineer - AI Verticals
job.description:
What you can expect

As an AI Engineer specializing in Agentic AI, you will develop intelligent agents that can autonomously perceive, reason, and act in dynamic environments as part of Zoom AI Companion (AIC).

Your work will directly impact the Zoom user experience by designing and implementing innovative algorithms and systems. These enhancements will improve workplace efficiency and customer engagement across Zoom Virtual Agent (ZVA), Zoom Customer Experience (ZCX) and Zoom Workplace, serving vertical domains like healthcare, education, banking, and insurance.


 

About the Team

We are part of the Zoom AI Vertical Organization, dedicated to enhancing the Zoom user experience in workplace and customer interactions. Our team of innovative thinkers is focused on creating the next generation of AI technologies that can autonomously understand, learn, and adapt to improve user engagement and satisfaction. We are seeking an AI engineer to join our team and contribute to our groundbreaking Agentic AI project.


 

Responsibilities

  • Designing and implementing backend orchestration layers between AI components within microservices, focusing on agent workflows and runtime operations.

  • Building scalable LLM-powered systems including RAG pipelines, tool-use workflows, and multi-step reasoning agents.

  • Building AI agents using frameworks like LangChain, Dify, OpenAI SDK or internal orchestration system through code (not no-code tools), ensuring proper agent flow implementation.

  • Developing integration between various AI components including LLM, RAG, TTS (Text-to-Speech), and ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) systems.

  • Writing and optimizing prompts for AI agents, conduct integration testing, and ensure proper functionality of agent systems.

  • Collaborating with research and product engineering teams to implement agent-based solutions that enhance user experience across vertical domains.

What we’re looking for

  • Possess a Bachelor's in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Cognitive Science or related field, and 10+ years industry experience (or a Master's and 8+ years, or a PhD + 5 years).

  • Show an understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, reinforcement learning, cognitive architectures, and multi-modality including speech and vision.

  • Exhibit development skills in programming languages such as Python, C++, or Java, and experience with AI frameworks and libraries (e.g., PyTorch).

  • Have familiarity with Multiple Agent architectures and experience in designing and implementing multi-agent systems.

  • Utilize problem-solving skills and the ability to think creatively and critically about complex problems.

  • Communicate and collaborate with the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

job.title: SDK Engineer
job.description:
Immigration sponsorship is not available for this position

What you can expect

SDK Engineer will be responsible for cross-platform development, designing new features & and supporting the client & server teams to ensure Zoom Phone SDK is reliable and stable. They will provide continuous enhancements, and work with both internal & external customers on any issues they may have.

Responsibilities:  

  • Design the overall architecture for Zoom Phone tasks and communicate interfaces with server and client teams. This includes detailed control flow at SIP level, specific command requests and responses between client, server, and UI layers.
  • Implement new features and unit test cases according to new feature implementation. Drive tasks across teams and make sure roll out features follow the release plan.
  • Conduct integration testing with server and client teams.
  • Use Windows Performance Analyzer (WPA) or relevant tool, to prevent memory leaks in SDK code.
  • Use Checkmarx to scan and fix SDK code issues.
  • Use User-Mode Dump Heap (UMDH) to capture and analyze heap memory allocations for a process.
  • Perform sanity testing to prevent crash and regression issues. Perform SDK API auto testing based on an internal tool.
  • Maintain auto testing tools and improve those tools to support more automatic testing scenarios.
  • Review customer tickets and work with support team, analyze control flow, SIP flow and determine root cause.
  • Examine client problem report on demand, analyze call details, and perform root cause analysis.
  • Review bugs with the reporter to understand bugs and reproduced steps, then perform root; cause analysis and determine a solution.
  • Perform integration testing at the development branch and release branch to ensure the fix has no negative impact.
  • Work closely with the product management team to define requirements, create user stories and collect use cases on new features.
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams to confirm final design scope and assign task owners. Support client team with fire drill testing before rolling out new releases and check the production crash reports after new release roll-out.
  • Work on enhancements for our automatic client report analysis tool.
  • Track critical and important issues found in client problem reports.

What we're looking for:

Requires a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, a related field, or a foreign degree equivalent. Requires 4 years of experience in the job offered or a related occupation. Requires 4 years of experience with the following skillsets:

  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing C/C++ and object-oriented programming in task design, fixing bugs, and implementing development work;
  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing Wireshark to analyze VOIP traffic calls in network programming;
  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing IDE tools including Microsoft Studio for debugging code;
  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing Valgrind to perform memory checks;
  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing Flame Graph to check CPU cost information and code enhancements;
  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing network protocols including TCP, UDP, TLS, RTP, SRTP, and RCTP in real-time traffic transmission and audio quality enhancements;
  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing VoIP technologies including RFC2833, RFC3550 and RFC 5760 in real time communication to control system traffic, control audio quality, and develop solutions to ensure quality user experience;
  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing open-source projects including SIP stacks (PJSIP, reSIProcate, FreeSWITCH) to support fundamental layer covering low-level SIP protocol parsing;
  • Requires 4 years experience in utilizing integrated development environments (IDEs) including Visual Studio in software development.
  • Telecommuting work arrangement permitted. Position may work in various unanticipated locations throughout the U.S. Position does not require U.S. or domestic travel.
